title: Runtime/compiler extension audit
mission: Inspect the current Agent Network/runtime/compiler/bootstrap implementation and produce the smallest concrete change map needed to add Chat Object, Work Item, Worker Run and derived batch state without rebuilding existing coordination.
why: The product must reuse Agent Network v3/EPOCH/compiled packets while extending them cleanly for reincarnable Chat Objects and one-shot jobs.
must_preserve: no shared mutable worker status file
done_when: A parent can implement the extensions from the audit without repeating repository archaeology.
stop_only_if: Required source cannot be loaded or contradictory authority cannot be resolved from durable state.
